definitions.explanation: Something one is good at or skilled in, with the polite prefix お.
A customer who frequently does business with a shop or company.

examples.japanese: ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧お{得意|とくい}なんです⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: You're good at cooking, aren't you?

examples.japanese: ⟦ピアノ→ピアノ：01376_piano⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧お{得意|とくい}です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
お{得意|とくい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手品|てじな}→手品：03443_tejina⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せて→見せる：01988_miseru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please show us your specialty magic trick.

examples.japanese: お{得意|とくい}さま⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いらっしゃいました→いらっしゃる：01295_irassharu⟧。
⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{得意|とくい}さま⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{特別|とくべつ}→特別：01120_tokubetsu⟧⟦{割引|わりびき}→割引：01526_waribiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提供|ていきょう}する→提供する：21736_teikyousuru⟧。
examples.english: We offer special discounts to long-time customers.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{得意|とくい}さまになって{十年|じゅうねん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I've been a regular customer of this shop for ten years.

notes:
お{得意|とくい} has two distinct meanings depending on context.

SENSE 1 (specialty):
Polite form of ⟦{得意|とくい}→得意：03455_tokui⟧ (strong point). Used when asking about or praising someone's skills.

SENSE 2 (customer):
Often appears as お{得意|とくい}さま or お{得意|とくい}さん.
- お{得意|とくい}さま: valued customer (formal/business)
- お{得意|とくい}さん: regular customer (casual)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{得意|とくい}→得意：03455_tokui⟧: specialty; pride (without お)
- ⟦{常連|じょうれん}→常連：06878_jouren⟧: regular customer
- ⟦{顧客|こきゃく}→顧客：08632_kokyaku⟧: customer (formal)
